architecture_contract.blocks: stem convolution followed by four efficient convolution, squeeze-excitation, residual-concatenation, projection, and max-pooling stages
architecture_contract.output: one uncalibrated scalar lentiMPRA reporter-expression score per sequence
architecture_contract.warning: The exact Hugging Face artifact is one HepG2 file named test1_val2, not the ten-model cross-validation ensemble described by the author repository. Fold identity is inferred from the filename because no training receipt is bundled.

checkpoint.artifact_provenance: third_party_Hugging_Face_repackaging_of_the_author_architecture; equality to an author-released Zenodo checkpoint is unresolved

input_contract.alphabet_and_channel_order: A,G,C,T; N is encoded as 0.25 in every channel
input_contract.canonical_project_reference: GRCh38.p14 with REF-allele and coordinate validation before sequence construction
input_contract.gse281364_native_lane: Prefer the deposited assay oligo sequence only after its allele, orientation, adapter, barcode, and 230-bp construction are validated. A genomic window is a separately labeled transfer lane.
input_contract.indel_status: deferred until a length-preserving oligo construction and allele alignment fixture is frozen
input_contract.sequence_length: exactly 230 bp; reject silent truncation, padding, or mixed lengths
input_contract.snp_window: For coordinate-only transfer, use 115 upstream bases, the validated allele, and 114 downstream bases so the allele is at zero-based index 115
input_contract.strand_contract: score forward and reverse-complement sequences, then average scalar outputs; preserve ALT-minus-REF orientation
input_contract.training_domain: human lentiMPRA sequences in K562, HepG2, and WTC11; endogenous genomic-window inference is out-of-domain transfer
input_contract.warning: The checkpoint has four input channels and therefore does not use the optional reverse-orientation channel described by the author training code. No shift or primer sequence is added at inference.

representation_and_task_contract.gse281364_assay_native_diagnostic: ALT-minus-REF reporter score and allelic-direction agreement in HepG2 only. The same sequence score is repeated across control and PAOA and cannot predict a treatment interaction. LX-2 is an out-of-domain diagnostic, not a matched checkpoint result.
representation_and_task_contract.sealed_component_lane: A frozen ALT-minus-REF activity score may enter a separately named composite with an independently frozen enhancer-gene link and direction rule.
representation_and_task_contract.standalone_primary_endpoint_status: ineligible because a reporter activity delta does not identify a target gene or a signed cell-type eQTL/ieQTL effect

source_evidence: The author repository, its Zenodo record 10558183, and the exact Hugging Face revision were queried on 2026-08-22. Public source text, repository metadata, and the 132-byte Git LFS pointer were read. No checkpoint, package, training data, or assay data was downloaded, and no model code was executed.
